solution_steps: Flip White Ninja to destroy Castle Gate.
Activate Ninjitsu Art of Transformation and summon Big Koala from your hand.
Normal summon Bazoo the Soul-Eater and use his effect to remove White Ninja from game.
Activate The Big March of Animals and attack directly.
